title: Markdown table stretches to full width with bright white rules and a leading blank row
observed: A two-column table (Route | Limit) is spread across all 120 columns so 'Limit' starts at column 60, far from its values' labels; the header rule and column divider draw in bright white, louder than any other line on screen; an empty row separates it from the kiln label.
expected: Tables size to their content, rules use the design's hairline colour (#3a3228 / #2f2920 family), and the body starts on the row under the label.
